-- Tržby z prodejen
SELECT 'Tržby z prodejen' AS record_type,
       ss.ss_ticket_number AS document_number,
       ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
       ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
       'datum prodeje' AS date_kind,
       CAST(ss.ss_quantity AS VARCHAR) AS state
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN store_market m ON m.s_market_id = st.s_market_id
WHERE ({market_id} = '' OR m.s_market_id = {market_id})
  AND st.s_state = 'TN'
  AND ss.ss_net_profit >= 0
  AND m.s_market_desc COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {market_name}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Reklamace z prodejen
SELECT 'Reklamace z prodejen' AS record_type,
       sr.sr_ticket_number AS document_number,
       sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
       sr.sr_return_time_sk AS time_sk,
       'datum přijetí reklamace' AS date_kind,
       CAST(sr.sr_return_quantity AS VARCHAR) AS state
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
WHERE ({market_id} = '' OR st.s_market_id = {market_id})
  AND st.s_state = 'TN'
  AND sr.sr_return_amt >= 0
  AND st.s_market_desc COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {market_name}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Ztrátové tržby z prodejen
SELECT 'Ztrátové tržby' AS record_type,
       ss.ss_ticket_number AS document_number,
       ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
       ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
       'datum prodeje' AS date_kind,
       CAST(ss.ss_quantity AS VARCHAR) AS state
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN store_market m ON m.s_market_id = st.s_market_id
WHERE ({market_id} = '' OR m.s_market_id = {market_id})
  AND st.s_state = 'TN'
  AND ss.ss_net_profit < 0
  AND m.s_market_desc COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {market_name}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Storna reklamací
SELECT 'Storno reklamace' AS record_type,
       sr.sr_ticket_number AS document_number,
       sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
       sr.sr_return_time_sk AS time_sk,
       'datum storna' AS date_kind,
       CAST(sr.sr_return_quantity AS VARCHAR) AS state
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
WHERE ({market_id} = '' OR st.s_market_id = {market_id})
  AND st.s_state = 'TN'
  AND sr.sr_return_amt < 0
  AND st.s_market_desc COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {market_name}, '%')
ORDER BY date_sk DESC;

SELECT
       I.i_item_sk,
       I.i_item_id,
       I.i_product_name,
       I.i_category_id,
       case I.i_category_id
           when 1 then 'Women'
           when 2 then 'Men'
           when 3 then 'Children'
           when 4 then 'Shoes'
           else 'Unknown'
       end                             AS category_label,
       case
           when I.i_category_id in (1,4) then 'Apparel'
           when I.i_category_id in (2,3) then 'Accessories'
           else 'Unspecified'
       end                             AS department,
       I.i_manufact_id,
       case I.i_manufact_id
           when 0 then 'Active'
           when 1 then 'Inactive'
           else 'Unknown'
       end                             AS item_state,
       K.i_category                    AS category_name,
       C.i_class                       AS class_name,
       case
           when I.i_item_id = {search_term} then 'Item code'
           when I.i_formulation = {search_term} then 'Formulation code'
           when P.p_promo_id = {search_term} then 'Promotion code'
           when I.i_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', {search_term}, '%') then 'Name (full text)'
           else 'Other'
       end                             AS matched_by
FROM item I WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN item_category K WITH(NOLOCK) ON K.i_category_id = I.i_category_id
LEFT JOIN item_class C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.i_class_id = I.i_class_id
LEFT JOIN promotion P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.p_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
                                         AND P.p_promo_id = {search_term}
WHERE ISNULL(I.i_manufact_id, 0) = 0
  AND I.i_manager_id = 1
  AND (
        I.i_item_id = {search_term}
     OR I.i_formulation = {search_term}
     OR P.p_promo_id = {search_term}
     OR I.i_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', {search_term}, '%')
      )
ORDER BY
    case
        when I.i_item_id = {search_term} then 1
        when I.i_formulation = {search_term} then 2
        when P.p_promo_id = {search_term} then 3
        else 4
    end,
    I.i_item_id;

SELECT
       INV.inv_warehouse_sk            AS warehouse,
       INV.inv_date_sk                 AS snapshot_week,
       I.i_item_id,
       I.i_product_name,
       INV.inv_quantity_on_hand        AS on_hand,
       I.i_current_price               AS price,
       I.i_wholesale_cost              AS cost,
       -- category 3 items in 'Unknown' containers report the price signal instead of the stock signal
       case
           when I.i_category_id = 3 AND I.i_container = 'Unknown' then
               case
                   when I.i_current_price > 0
                       then 'Priced (' + CAST(CAST(I.i_current_price as int) as varchar(20)) + ' USD)'
                   when I.i_current_price = 0
                       then 'Unpriced (0 USD)'
                   when I.i_current_price < 0
                       then 'Negative price (by '
                            + CAST(CAST(ABS(I.i_current_price) as int) as varchar(20)) + ' USD)'
                   else 'Price unknown'
               end
           else
               case
                   when INV.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
                       then 'In stock (' + CAST(CAST(INV.inv_quantity_on_hand as int) as varchar(20)) + ' units)'
                   when INV.inv_quantity_on_hand = 0
                       then 'Out of stock (0 units)'
                   when INV.inv_quantity_on_hand < 0
                       then 'Shortfall (overdrawn by '
                            + CAST(CAST(ABS(INV.inv_quantity_on_hand) as int) as varchar(20)) + ' units)'
                   else 'Stock unknown'
               end
       end                             AS availability,
       case
           when I.i_wholesale_cost > 0 then 'OK'
           when I.i_wholesale_cost <= 0 then 'CRITICAL'
           else '?'
       end                             AS cost_signal
FROM inventory INV WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN item I WITH(NOLOCK) ON I.i_item_sk = INV.inv_item_sk
WHERE ({item_sk} = '' OR INV.inv_item_sk = {item_sk})
  AND ({item_code} = '' OR I.i_item_id = {item_code})
  AND ({product_name} = '' OR I.i_product_name COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {product_name}, '%'))
 /* AND INV.inv_quantity_on_hand <> 0 */
ORDER BY INV.inv_warehouse_sk;

SELECT
       I.i_item_id,
       MAX(I.i_product_name)           AS i_product_name,
       SUM(I.i_current_price)          AS current_price_total,
       SUM(I.i_wholesale_cost)         AS wholesale_cost_total,
       case
           when SUM(I.i_current_price) > 0 then 'On sale'
           when SUM(I.i_current_price) = 0 then 'Borderline'
           else 'Not on sale'
       end                             AS sale_state
FROM item I WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE I.i_item_id = {item_code}
  AND I.i_current_price <> 0
GROUP BY I.i_item_id;

SELECT
       I.i_item_id,
       I.i_product_name,
       case I.i_category_id
           when 1 then 'Women'
           when 2 then 'Men'
           when 3 then 'Children'
           when 4 then 'Shoes'
       end                             AS category_label,
       case
           when I.i_category_id in (1,4) then 'Apparel'
           when I.i_category_id in (2,3) then 'Accessories'
           else 'Unspecified'
       end                             AS department,
       I.i_brand                       AS brand_name,
       I.i_class,
       I.i_rec_start_date              AS valid_from,
       I.i_current_price               AS list_price,
       I.i_wholesale_cost              AS wholesale_cost,
       I.i_size                        AS size_label,
       I.i_color                       AS color_label,
       I.i_units                       AS unit_label,
       I.i_manager_id                  AS manager_id,
       I.i_rec_end_date                AS valid_to,
       I.i_manufact                    AS manufacturer,
       case
           when I.i_rec_start_date < GETDATE() then 'Date passed'
           when I.i_rec_start_date = CAST(GETDATE() as date) then 'Today'
           else 'Expected: ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), I.i_rec_start_date, 104)
       end                             AS date_info
FROM item I WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE I.i_rec_start_date >= GETDATE()
  AND I.i_current_price > 0
  AND I.i_manager_id IN (2, 4, 6)
  AND I.i_item_id = {item_code}
ORDER BY I.i_rec_start_date ASC, I.i_brand;

SELECT
       I.i_item_id,
       I.i_product_name,
       'Store'                         AS source_type,
       M.s_market_code                 AS market_code,
       case M.s_market_code
           when 'MID' then 'Midwest'
           when 'EAS' then 'East'
           when 'WES' then 'West'
       end                             AS market_label,
       S.s_store_id                    AS store_code,
       S.s_rec_start_date              AS valid_from,
       S.s_rec_end_date                AS valid_to,
       S.s_number_employees            AS employees,
       case S.s_number_employees
           when -2 then 'Not recorded'
           when 0  then 'Unstaffed'
           when 1  then 'Single employee'
           when 3  then 'Small store'
           else 'Employees: ' + CAST(S.s_number_employees as varchar(5))
       end                             AS staffing,
       SS.ss_ext_sales_price           AS revenue,
       C.i_class                       AS class_name,
       case
           when S.s_rec_end_date IS NULL then 'Validity open'
           when S.s_rec_end_date < GETDATE() then 'Validity ended'
           else 'Valid until: ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), S.s_rec_end_date, 104)
       end                             AS validity_info
FROM store S WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN store_market M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.s_market_id = S.s_market_id
LEFT JOIN store_sales SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.ss_store_sk = S.s_store_sk
                                AND SS.ss_quantity IN (1,2)
LEFT JOIN item I WITH(NOLOCK) ON I.i_item_sk = SS.ss_item_sk
LEFT JOIN item_class C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.i_class_id = I.i_class_id
WHERE M.s_market_code IN ('MID','EAS','WES')
  AND S.s_number_employees IN (-2, 0, 1)
  AND I.i_item_id = {item_code}
ORDER BY S.s_rec_end_date ASC;

SELECT MIN(cr.cr_order_number) AS cr_order_number,
       d.d_quarter_name,
       c.i_class_code,
       c.i_class,
       r.r_reason_id,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS cr_return_amount,
       -SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS revenue_impact
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN item_class c ON c.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
WHERE (c.i_class_code COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT({class_name}, '%')
   OR c.i_class COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {class_name}, '%'))
  AND d.d_quarter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', {period}, '%')
  AND substring(r.r_reason_desc,1,1) in ('D','N','P','S')
GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk, cr.cr_item_sk,
         d.d_quarter_name, c.i_class_code, c.i_class,
         r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC;

SELECT MIN(i.i_item_sk) AS i_item_sk,
       k.i_category,
       c.i_class_code,
       c.i_class,
       b.i_brand_code,
       b.i_brand,
       SUM(i.i_current_price) AS i_current_price,
       -SUM(i.i_current_price) AS price_reversal
FROM item i
JOIN item_class c ON c.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
JOIN item_category k ON k.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
JOIN item_brand b ON b.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
WHERE c.i_class_id = {class_id}
  AND k.i_category_id = {category_id}
  AND substring(b.i_brand_code,1,1) in ('5','6','8','9')
GROUP BY i.i_category_id, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id,
         k.i_category, c.i_class_code, c.i_class,
         b.i_brand_code, b.i_brand
ORDER BY SUM(i.i_current_price) DESC;

  AND d.d_quarter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', {period}, '%')
  AND substring(r.r_reason_desc,1,1) in ('D','N','P','S')

         d.d_quarter_name, r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc,
         cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name
ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC;

SELECT cr.cr_order_number,
       d.d_quarter_name,
       r.r_reason_id,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       cc.cc_call_center_id,
       cc.cc_name,
       cr.cr_return_amount AS cr_return_amount,
       -cr.cr_return_amount AS revenue_impact,
       i.i_item_id,
       i.i_product_name,
       i.i_brand
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT TOP 1 x.cr_returned_date_sk FROM catalog_returns x WHERE x.cr_order_number = {order_number})
  AND cr.cr_reason_sk = (SELECT TOP 1 x.cr_reason_sk FROM catalog_returns x WHERE x.cr_order_number = {order_number})
  AND cr.cr_call_center_sk = (SELECT TOP 1 x.cr_call_center_sk FROM catalog_returns x WHERE x.cr_order_number = {order_number})
ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC;

WITH ret AS
  (SELECT x.cr_item_sk, x.cr_call_center_sk FROM catalog_returns x WHERE x.cr_order_number = {order_number})
SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk,
       c.i_class,
       i.i_item_id,
       i.i_rec_start_date,
       i.i_brand_id,
       cc.cc_call_center_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       cc.cc_employees,
       cc.cc_sq_ft,
       cc.cc_class,
       cc.cc_hours,
       cc.cc_name,
       cc.cc_manager,
       cc.cc_tax_percentage,
       cc.cc_gmt_offset,
       i.i_current_price
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN item_class c ON c.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = (SELECT cr_call_center_sk FROM ret)
WHERE i.i_item_sk = (SELECT cr_item_sk FROM ret)
ORDER BY cc.cc_employees;

SELECT
       r_reason_sk,
       r_reason_id,
       r_reason_desc
FROM reason
WHERE substring(r_reason_desc,1,1) in ('D','N','P','S')
  AND len(r_reason_id) = 16
  AND ({reason} = '' OR r_reason_id COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {reason}, '%')
       OR r_reason_desc COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {reason}, '%'))
ORDER BY r_reason_id;

SELECT
       cc_call_center_sk,
       cc_call_center_id,
       cc_name
FROM call_center
WHERE ({call_center_name} = '' OR cc_call_center_id COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {call_center_name}, '%')
       OR cc_name COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {call_center_name}, '%'))
ORDER BY cc_call_center_id;

SELECT
       i_class_id,
       i_class_code,
       i_class
FROM item_class
WHERE ({class_name} = '' OR i_class_code COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {class_name}, '%')
       OR i_class COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {class_name}, '%'))
ORDER BY i_class_code;

SELECT
       store.s_store_sk,
       store.s_store_id,
       store.s_store_name,
       item.i_item_sk,
       item.i_item_id,
       item.i_product_name,
       store_division.s_division_name,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), dbo.fn_store_item_price(item.i_item_sk, store.s_store_sk, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))) AS store_price,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), dbo.fn_market_item_price(item.i_item_sk, store_market.s_market_id, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))) AS market_price,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), ISNULL(dbo.fn_store_item_price(item.i_item_sk, store.s_store_sk, CONVERT(date, GETDATE())),
                                     dbo.fn_market_item_price(item.i_item_sk, store_market.s_market_id, CONVERT(date, GETDATE())))) AS effective_price
FROM store
JOIN store_market ON store_market.s_market_id = store.s_market_id AND store_market.s_market_code = 'MAIN'
JOIN store_division ON store_division.s_division_id = store_market.s_division_id
JOIN item ON item.i_manager_id = 1 AND item.i_manufact_id = 0
WHERE (store.s_store_name COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {store_name}, '%')
       OR store.s_store_id COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {store_name}, '%'))
  AND (item.i_item_id COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {item_code}, '%')
       OR item.i_product_name COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {item_code}, '%'))

SELECT
       item.i_item_sk,
       promotion.p_promo_id,
       promotion.p_promo_name,
       item_brand.i_brand_code,
       item_brand.i_brand,
       item_category.i_category_code,
       item_class.i_class,
       date_dim.d_day_name,
       item.i_formulation,
       CASE
            WHEN item.i_brand_id IS NOT NULL AND item.i_formulation NOT LIKE '%@%' THEN 'P1'
            WHEN item.i_brand_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P2'
            WHEN item.i_class_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P3'
            WHEN item.i_category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P4'
            WHEN item_category.i_category_code = 'Full assortment' THEN 'P6'
            ELSE 'P5'
       END AS rule_priority,
       item.i_rec_start_date,
       item.i_rec_end_date
FROM item
JOIN promotion ON promotion.p_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN item_brand ON item_brand.i_brand_id = item.i_brand_id
LEFT JOIN item_category ON item_category.i_category_id = item.i_category_id
LEFT JOIN item_class ON item_class.i_class_id = item.i_class_id
LEFT JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = promotion.p_start_date_sk
WHERE item.i_manager_id = 2
  AND CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) BETWEEN item.i_rec_start_date AND ISNULL(item.i_rec_end_date, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
  AND (promotion.p_promo_name COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {promo_name}, '%')
       OR promotion.p_promo_id COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {promo_name}, '%'))
ORDER BY promotion.p_promo_name, rule_priority, item_category.i_category_code;

SELECT
       item.i_item_sk,
       item_category.i_category_code,
       item_brand.i_brand_code,
       item_brand.i_brand,
       item.i_formulation,
       item.i_rec_start_date,
       item.i_rec_end_date
FROM item
JOIN item_category ON item_category.i_category_id = item.i_category_id
LEFT JOIN item_brand ON item_brand.i_brand_id = item.i_brand_id
WHERE item.i_manager_id = 2
  AND item.i_class_id IS NULL
  AND CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) BETWEEN item.i_rec_start_date AND ISNULL(item.i_rec_end_date, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
  AND item_category.i_category_code LIKE CONCAT('%', {category_code}, '%')
ORDER BY item_category.i_category_code, item_brand.i_brand;

SELECT
       store.s_store_sk,
       store_market.s_market_code,
       store_division.s_division_code,
       store_division.s_division_name,
       store.s_gmt_offset,
       store.s_tax_precentage,
       store.s_floor_space,
       store.s_number_employees
FROM store
JOIN store_market ON store_market.s_market_id = store.s_market_id
JOIN store_division ON store_division.s_division_id = store.s_division_id
WHERE store.s_company_id = 0
  AND ({market_code} = '' OR store_market.s_market_code COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {market_code}, '%'))
  AND ({division_code} = '' OR store_division.s_division_code COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {division_code}, '%'))
ORDER BY store_market.s_market_code, store_division.s_division_code, store.s_tax_precentage;
